levels.surface: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر

notes: Two routes carry the same saying and both reach «صالح بن كيسان»: one through «الأعرج عبد الرحمن، وغيره» from Abu Hurayra, one through Nafiʿ from Ibn Umar. Each is written in full, since the text names the head again only once.
«أنهما حدثاه» is read as both routes narrated to Salih; the pronoun is not otherwise named.
«وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter at the same level.
